## Summary

```text
Capture the full pending release range
  Render the pending changelog once
    Write the pending section to CHANGELOG.md
    Preview the same section in the release PR description
```

Refreshing the same PR includes new entries under the existing changelog groups. Existing proposals verify against their original description format. Oversized previews point reviewers to the complete file in **Files changed**.

## Evidence

- **Before** The rolling proposal test fails on main because the release PR body has no Features section.
- **After** The same test shows Features on creation and Features plus Fixes on refresh, with the PR preview matching the pending changelog. Focused tests also cover legacy reconstruction, edited preview rejection, and the size fallback. `pnpm verify` and the commit hooks passed all 822 tests.

## Merge Danger

**Door** Two-way for release output and versioning. Keep a compatible verifier for any proposal already created with the new description format.

**Blast Radius** Release proposal creation, refresh, and approval.

```release-log
version: 1
audience: users
summary: Preview the pending changelog in release pull requests.
impact: Review the complete pending batch in the release pull request as new changes land.
required_action: null
```

## Summary

For same-repository `release-log/main` proposals authored by the configured release App, skip the container smoke job and full `pnpm verify` suite. Keep the required `verify` job, its proposal freshness and metadata checks, and main-push Quality runs used for self-upgrade admission.

Container Security skips those proposals and pushes that can be tied to their exact merge commit. Documentation skips builds and deploys when its inputs are unchanged, including package version-only bumps. Scheduled and manual scans and tag-triggered publication checks still run.

## Evidence

- **Before** — Generated release PRs run both full Quality build jobs.
- **After** — The workflow parsed, the guard assertions and shell syntax checks passed, and `git diff --check` passed. Local Git fixtures verified that a version-only bump skips the docs build and that docs or build-script changes still trigger it. Use a merge commit to preserve the unscoped authored subject.

## Release context

```release-log
version: 1
audience: internal
summary: "Skip redundant CI builds on generated release proposals."
impact: "Release proposals use less CI compute."
required_action: null
```

## Merge Danger

**Door** — Two-way. Revert the workflow change to restore the previous CI runs.

**Blast radius** — Release proposal CI.

Closes #102.

## Summary

```text
Verified Git range → ordinary PR readiness → snapshot → release plan
  Scoped PR title classifies the PR.
  Original and landed commit subjects accept either scope form.
  Breaking conflicts still block capture with the rule and commit SHA.
```

Metadata failures also identify the PR and affected field. Snapshot normalization moves to revision 4. Existing snapshots require a compatible pinned producer or fresh capture and review.

## Evidence

- **Before** — a scoped authored commit or a squash subject copied from a scoped PR title could stop snapshot capture.
- **After** — the real-Git merge and squash fixtures produce the same PR entry and minor bump. The fixed-onboarding fixture accepts the scoped post-cutoff commit. The packaged CLI reports the failing field without printing PR prose.
- `pnpm verify` passed on current `main` with 819 tests. The live Upkeep rehearsal with the original cutoff is pending a reviewed candidate.

## Merge Danger

**Door** — two-way. Keep the previous producer available for replay of snapshots it created.

**Blast radius** — release validation and snapshot replay.

```release-log
version: 1
audience: users
summary: Accept conventional commits with or without scopes during ordinary release validation.
impact: Squash subjects copied from PR titles can pass release validation, and preview errors identify the metadata needing repair.
required_action: null
```

pullRequests.body:
## Summary

```text
pnpm test              fast tests or an explicitly selected file
pnpm test:integration Git, CLI and package integration tests
pnpm test:all         all behavioral tests
pnpm verify           all behavioral tests with coverage plus static checks and docs
```

Batch Git index updates in proposal fixtures. Reuse compiled modules in the packed CLI test and run isolated CLI scenarios concurrently.

## Evidence

- Before this change, plain `pnpm test` ran the full suite with coverage.
- On this branch, `pnpm test` passed **295 tests in 3.01 seconds**.
- The pre-commit hook passed formatting, lint, type checks, all **827 tests** with coverage, and the docs build in about **3m 39s**. The packed CLI test took **82.4 seconds**.
- The docs build emitted an `ES2024` target warning and completed.

## Merge danger

**Door** Two-way  
**Blast radius** Test tooling

Plain `pnpm test` selects the fast suite. Full verification still exercises both suites.

## Release context

```release-log
version: 1
audience: internal
summary: Make fast behavioral tests the default and reduce repeated setup in Git and CLI integration tests.
impact: Contributors can get local test feedback in seconds and run full verification with coverage when needed.
required_action: null
```
